description: Defines two utility functions for testing purposes: one for creating a temporary directory and another for creating an executable file at a specified path.

methods.name: makeTempDirForTests
methods.description: Creates and returns a temporary directory URL for testing purposes.

methods.name: makeExecutableForTests
methods.description: Creates an executable file at the specified URL with executable permissions.

parameters.name: at
parameters.description: The file URL where the executable will be created.
